tagline: Most portfolios show the work. This one ships it.

about.title: What is this?
about.body:
This is my portfolio. Not screenshots of it — the actual work, handmade, and you can buy it.

I'm Augusto, a software engineer from Brazil. Everything in this shop is really made by hand, by me: letters written with an actual pen, drawings on actual paper. When you buy something, I make it, and I mail it to wherever you are (or email it, for the digital pieces).

The shop itself is the engineering exhibit: a MERN + Stripe storefront with real payments, running end to end. The source code is public — check the repository to see how it's built.

Why? Because most portfolios show the work. This one ships it.
